facts.fact: The article says the 3G switch-off by 30 June 2027 forms part of Rwanda's ICT Sector Strategic Plan 2024-2029, the digital transformation roadmap; the date is the article's publication date, as it gives none for the period's statement.
MINICT set 30 June 2027 as the nationwide 3G switch-off date, with pilot shutdowns in 2026 and 2G to follow, after a 24 July 2026 cabinet briefing, as part of the ICT Sector Strategic Plan 2024-2029.
